title: Ricardo Gill — Digital preservation and research reproducibility
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Direct workflow fit; restoration and fidelity must be tested

finder_profile.audience: Digital preservation and research reproducibility researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Maintain source versions, checksums, explicit amendments and interpretable metadata. Distinguish original equations from later proposed formalisations and retain negative results.
illustrative_example: A future reviewer distinguishes an original EBR equation from a later teaching example using dated editions and source labels.
evaluation_targets: Restoration success, checksum verification, edition attribution and reproducibility of analyses.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
